title: [bundle] Reconcile the local prompt_hub checkout with origin/main aft
objective: Reconcile the local prompt_hub checkout with origin/main after the merged fleet sync without discarding unrelated user dirt. Preserve prompt_hub .idea local changes. Remove the false local deletion/dirty signal for fleet deployment artifacts so prompt_hub no longer appears to delete origin/main .gitignore .handoff .claude .github or scripts artifacts. Prove git diff --name-status origin/main -- .gitignore .handoff .claude .github scripts is clean, prompt_hub is fast-forwarded to origin/main, and handoff fleet sync/status remain clean.
acceptance_criteria: prompt_hub local main is fast-forwarded to origin/main without discarding unrelated local .idea dirt.
The fleet deployment artifact diff is clean: cd ../prompt_hub && git diff --quiet origin/main -- .gitignore .handoff .claude .github scripts.
Handoff fleet sync dry-run remains resolved with remediated == 0, all_resolved == true, and no failures.
Handoff fleet status reports zero gaps.
test_commands: cd ../prompt_hub && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
hf fleet sync --dry-run --json | jq -e '.remediated == 0 and .all_resolved == true and ((.failures // []) | length == 0)'
